therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Dual immune checkpoint blockade targeting TIGIT and PD-1
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and anti-tumor immune response enhancement
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Participants with untreated limited-stage small cell lung cancer

results.effect_size: Median PFS: Ociperlimab + Tislelizumab 12.6 months (95% CI: 8.7–NA) vs Tislelizumab alone 13.2 months (95% CI: 8.5–NA) vs cCRT 9.5 months (95% CI: 8.3–14.4)
safety_signals: Higher SAE rate in combination arm (25/41) vs tislelizumab alone (20/42) vs cCRT (12/43)
Upper GI hemorrhage in combination arm
results.dose_information: Ociperlimab 900 mg IV every 3 weeks, Tislelizumab 200 mg IV every 3 weeks, with concurrent chemoradiotherapy (cisplatin/carboplatin + etoposide + thoracic RT 60-70 Gy)
